title: PhD Position in Physical AI: Adaptive Foundation Models for Robotics
about: Three-year PhD in the Adaptive & Agentic AI (A3) Lab, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, supervised by Behzad Bozorgtabar. Research covers vision-language-action models, world models and planning, and adaptation for robots. Preferred start 1 January 2027.
requirements: Master's degree (120 ECTS or equivalent) in computer science, electrical or computer engineering, robotics, machine learning or a related field, completed by enrolment
Evidence of research potential (substantial thesis, research project, code contribution or similar)

upskill.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems II
why: skill 'Vision-language-action models' → objective 'Foundation models for robotics: RT-2, PaLM-E - language-conditioned robot policies'
field 'Physical AI and robotics' → objective 'Sim-to-real transfer: training in simulation, deploying in the physical world'
